result.reason: The clause adds transition assistance for six months and machine-readable data return, but it does not require data export within 30 days or certification of deletion thereafter, so it meets neither the preferred nor fallback position. It also applies only upon termination or expiry of Maintenance Services rather than any expiry or termination of the Agreement, and uses Schedule A rates rather than then-current rates. Requiring return at Garman's cost is an unnecessary additional commercial change. The existing termination mechanics otherwise remain intact, but “Sparkling data” should be consistently defined and capitalized.
